title: Motion (Jurado - Lee) relative to: 1) instructing the Department of Building and Safety (DBS), in coordination with the City Attorney's Office, to report…
text:
[Council File 26-0906-S11; CD 14]
Motion (Jurado - Lee) relative to: 1) instructing the Department of Building and Safety (DBS), in coordination with the City Attorney's Office, to report back within the next 7 days on the City’s current citation and fine structure, and provide recommendations for increasing penalties for notices of violations and/or noncompliance on projects that impose a significant impact to the community, as seen in the 1400 South Los Palos Street incident, these recommendations should include a fee and fine structure that ranges from $25,000 to $1,000,000 per fine; 2) instructing the Community Investment Department (CID), with the assistance of DBS and the City Attorney's Office, to report with a proposed mechanism to dedicate a specific amount or percentage of any fees and fines collected as a result of non-compliance findings at the building located at above address, toward financial support for those directly affected by the Lineage Warehouse fire; and, 3) instructing CID to report with recommendations for a financial support program funded by the fees and fines described above, to include, but not be limited to, a guaranteed income component for businesses, residents, and workers directly impacted by the Lineage Warehouse fire.
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted

outcome.text: Council adopted Motion (Jurado - McOsker) to adopt the Ad Hoc Committee for Boyle Heights Fire Recovery Committee Report, subject to reconsideration, pursuant to Council Rule 51 (Sep 16, 2026); Council adopted Motion (Jurado - McOsker) to adopt the Ad Hoc Committee for Boyle Heights Fire Recovery Committee Report, subject to reconsideration, pursuant to Council Rule 51 (Sep 16, 2026); Council action final
